findings: src/execution/radix_partitioned_hashtable.cpp: FindClusteredRuns is now a single branch-free pass that records run heads and per-row run ids, and the redundant FindRunHeads pass is removed. It is a general change to how runs are detected on any integer clustered leading key. It adds no conditions keyed to a query, table or data distribution, and when streaming is used is unchanged.

Bounds are safe. heads[n] is written with n <= i <= count-1, and count <= STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE is checked by the caller. run_heads is allocated with STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE in the constructor, and run_ids is allocated lazily with the same size. count==0 returns early in SinkClustered.

Semantics are preserved. Before, the function returned false at the first decrease; now decreasing is accumulated without branching and the result is the same. first_end=heads[1] and last_start=heads[run_count-1] match the old values, including the single-key case (first_end==count). Validity is still checked before the pass, so NULL keys still fall back.

SinkInteriorRuns is only called when first_end < last_start, which implies run_count >= 3, so the D_ASSERT holds. The non-owning view heads[1..] gives get_index(0)==begin and get_index(run_count)==end. The address fill (run_ids[i]-1)*stride maps rows in [begin,end) to interior runs 0..run_count-1, the same as the old per-run loop.
No changes to measurement, settings or tests. No dead code is left behind.
